verdict.rationale: The firm's own VC practice page covers equity work 'through the full series of equity funding rounds' up to exit. The TwoVenture hub spans Start & Seed through Scale & Growth, and a term sheet tool covers early rounds. The page also states deal volume ('over 150 venture capital deals in 2017' from London). Missing for 10: current deal-volume figures (the only stated number is from 2017 and covers one office), named representative transactions by round stage, explicit late-stage priced-round coverage, and independent corroboration.
